perspective:
From Alice Lim’s available perspective, she knows/accesses:

- She is Alice Lim, a dental hygienist, and she knows her own thoughts, feelings, intentions, and actions.
- She and Austin Moreno are old friends from high school; they have stayed close, have different career paths, often discuss personal/professional lives, and support each other.
- She has observed Austin becoming reserved lately when their conversations turn to his work. This made her concerned and curious, and she suspected he might be hiding something about his job performance, though she had no specifics.
- She invited Austin for coffee. She asked if everything was okay at the office. Austin told her it was “nothing really,” just usual ups and downs, then later said he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and that it was complicated.
- After that conversation, Alice believed Austin might be considering a career change due to dissatisfaction. She felt worried and decided to share her own healthcare experiences and discuss career paths.
- She asked Austin if he had thought about changing careers. Austin said he had, but didn’t know what other paths he could take, and asked for her suggestions. Alice suggested healthcare, offered to tell him more, and offered to connect him with contacts. Austin said it sounded interesting and wanted to know more.
- Alice sensed Austin was hesitant because of fear of the unknown; she felt frustration and empathy. She told him about her friend Lara, who switched to healthcare in her late 30s and was happier. Austin said it was inspiring but worried about risks and initial struggle. Alice encouraged him that growth comes from leaving comfort zones and offered support. Austin thanked her and said her support and real success stories helped.
- Seeing his openness, Alice felt encouraged and hopeful. She offered to connect him with a career counselor and friends in healthcare. Austin said that would be helpful and appreciated the connections. Alice said she would set up a meeting for next week. Austin thanked her and said he was looking forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings, Alice believed Austin was ready to take next steps and appreciated her help. She felt satisfaction and joy. She told him she was proud of his steps and asked how he felt. Austin said he felt excited, nervous, and grateful. Alice said that was normal and suggested regular check-ins. Austin agreed, saying it would keep him focused and that her perspective helped.
- Alice plans regular check-ins with Austin to discuss his progress and challenges.
- She only knows what Austin has told her and what she has observed or inferred; she does not know any hidden facts about his job performance or unspoken reasons beyond those statements.
